about_the_game:
Ready-Player-Go! is an exploration adventure game set in a recently evacuated city torn apart by mysterious sinkholes. You return broke and desperate, chasing rumors of hidden gold sealed behind a massive boulder, and the last surviving Golden Card said to hold great value.

No enemies. No timer. Just you, the wind, the hum of your car and the silence of a world that left you behind.

The City is Silent. The Gold is Real.

When the ground began to collapse, everyone fled.

Now the city stands empty, streets cracked open by sinkholes, echoes of lives abandoned overnight.

You return, broke and out of options, chasing the rumor of hidden gold buried in the caverns... and one last Golden Card that could change everything.

There are no enemies to fight, only your instincts, your memory, and a world that dares you to find what's been left behind.

Explore. Drive. Discover.

  • Navigate a vast open landscape of evacuated streets, crumbling roads, and eerie outskirts.

  • There's no quest marker to follow, only what you remember, what you notice, and what you dare to try.

  • Drive multiple vehicles, collecting items and unlock them as you go.

  • Piece together environmental clues to find paths through blocked areas and reach hidden caverns.

  • Master the art of observation. Every path, object or vehicle could hold the answer to your next move.

  • Immersive pacing designed for exploration, not combat, where progress comes through patience and perception.

More Than a Game. It's the Beginning of a Challenge

  • Ready-Player-Go! isn't just one story. It's the first chapter in a growing series and the world's first visual memory skill esports event (online connection required, date to be announced).

  • Each chapter brings a new game to explore and a unique one-time online quest competition for players who finish it.

  • Note: To be able to participate in any future online competition, you will have to finish the game first and wait for the esports event to be scheduled. For more information, please visit the FAQs on our website.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core AMD or Intel, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 12 compatible card with 6 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 24 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required. Internet connection required only for the esports event
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: A hardcore exploration adventure with hidden objects for players who enjoy visual challenges and patient, methodical gameplay. The city is gone, the roads are empty, but the gold is still out there. Explore a vast open landscape in a realistic treasure hunt where your visual memory is your only map.
